en: The image shows a group of men, apparently prisoners, sitting on the ground in a row, eating a meal. They are guarded by men with rifles. The men on the ground wear uniforms and fez hats, suggesting they are Ottoman soldiers. The photograph is monochrome and has a historical look. Below the image, there is printed text in four languages: Bulgarian, French, German, and English, describing the scene as a meal for Turkish prisoners in Stara Zagora.
